summary: 3 findings: 0 blocker, 0 high, 1 medium, 2 low. No blockers — Pre-deploy QA (Task 15) is unblocked. Findings are maintainability-only (DRY duplication of error-status extraction across 3 catch blocks; dead errors.verifyEmail.* keys; informational re-confirmation that silentTranslationWarn/silentFallbackWarn are inert under legacy:false — already approved deviation per decisions.md Task 2).

dimension_results.residual_strings: OK — no Cyrillic literals or visible English ≥3-char strings outside t()/$t() in pages/, layouts/, components/, app.vue. Verified via grep for Cyrillic ranges and manual scan of every <template> block. Brand 'Bot Funnel' is routed through t('brand.name') (verified default.vue:21).
dimension_results.nuxtlinklocale_parity: OK — zero raw <NuxtLink> in feature scope. All link components use <NuxtLinkLocale> (default.vue:21,40,41; auth pages: login:109,110, register:146, forgot-password:48,86, reset-password:79, verify-email:127,137; dashboard:18).
dimension_results.navigateto_localepath: OK — every navigateTo() call wraps the path in localePath() (login.vue:46, register.vue:55 object-form, reset-password.vue:58 object-form, profile.vue:179,208, layouts/default.vue:14, middleware/auth.global.ts:32,39). Object-form navigateTo({path: localePath(...), query}) at register/reset-password is correct — only the path field needs locale wrapping.
dimension_results.useapierror_factory: OK — useApiError() is invoked at module-level <script setup> (line 10) in login/register/reset-password/profile, never inside catch. forgot-password and verify-email correctly do NOT call useApiError (forgot-password keeps silent catch for anti-enumeration per Task 9 commit; verify-email uses state-machine pattern for token errors, not message rendering).
dimension_results.routerules_parity: OK — nuxt.config.ts:66-71 declares '/auth/**' explicitly and spreads nonDefaultAuthRouteRules (built from NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES via Object.fromEntries) — both branches share AUTH_HEADERS const ({X-Robots-Tag: 'noindex, nofollow', Referrer-Policy: 'no-referrer'}). Adding a 3rd locale only requires updating shared/i18n-locales.ts (Decision 14 / AC10 satisfied).
dimension_results.non_default_locales_constant: OK — NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES = ['en'] as const lives in shared/i18n-locales.ts (single source of truth). Consumed by nuxt.config.ts:1 (routeRules expansion) AND server/middleware/strip-invalid-locale.ts:1+5 (allow-list). No hardcoded ['en'] in either consumer (Decision 5 / AC10 / parity-drift defense satisfied).
dimension_results.duplicated_patterns: 1 finding (medium): inline status-extraction duplication in 3 catch blocks (reset-password.vue:60-61, verify-email.vue:39+104-105, profile.vue:98-99) reuses the same `e?.statusCode ?? e?.status ?? e?.response?.status` pattern that useApiError's extractStatus() already encapsulates. Acceptable in current architecture (these branches need numeric status for state-machine transitions, not localized strings — useApiError returns string only) but the helper could be exported.

authorized_exceptions_verified.decision_11_computedref_no_unref: Verified in dashboard.vue, profile.vue, and 5 auth pages: Zod schema is wrapped in computed() and passed AS-IS (`validationSchema: schemaComputed`) to useForm without .value or unref(). Explicit approved deviation per decisions.md Task 10 — NOT a finding.
authorized_exceptions_verified.i18n_config_location_deviation: i18n.config.ts is at frontend/i18n/i18n.config.ts (not frontend/i18n.config.ts as worded in spec). Approved deviation per decisions.md Task 2 — necessary because Nuxt 4 + i18n v9 default restructureDir:'i18n' resolves vueI18n path inside that dir. nuxt.config.ts:43 references it as './i18n.config.ts' relative to that dir. NOT a finding.

findings.issue: Inline status-extraction duplicates the logic encapsulated in useApiError's extractStatus(). The same pattern `(e as {...}).statusCode ?? .status ?? .response?.status` appears verbatim in verify-email.vue:39+104-105 and profile.vue:98-99. Three independent copies of identical code increase maintenance surface — if backend ever returns status under a new field (e.g. error.cause.status), all 3 sites must be updated in lockstep, with the useApiError extractor as a 4th place. Not a runtime bug because the branches consume numeric status to drive UI state-machine (linkInvalid / cooldown), not a localized message — useApiError's contract (returns string) does not cover state transitions.
findings.quote:
const status = (e as { statusCode?: number; status?: number; response?: { status?: number } })
    const code = status?.statusCode ?? status?.status ?? status?.response?.status
findings.recommendation: Export `extractStatus(error: unknown): number | null` from composables/useApiError.ts as a free function (already lives there as a private helper at line 7-14). Each catch block then becomes a one-liner: `const code = extractStatus(e)`. No semantic change — same null/NaN coercion via Number.isFinite, same field precedence. Reduces 4 copies to 1 source.
findings.anchored_to: Audit Dimension 7 (Duplicated patterns / DRY violations); useApiError factory at composables/useApiError.ts:7-14 already implements extractStatus as a module-private function.

findings.issue: silentTranslationWarn and silentFallbackWarn are Vue I18n Legacy-mode-only options. Under `legacy: false` (Composition API mode, line 2) they are read but have no runtime effect — the equivalent Composition-mode flags are `missingWarn` and `fallbackWarn` (boolean inverted). Decision 9's stated intent (production console-warning suppression for missing-key info-disclosure defense) is therefore not enforced at runtime. Already documented as approved deviation in decisions.md Task 2 (Round 1 review noted by code-reviewer as informational/non-blocking; AC11 spec text is literally satisfied by the keys' presence).
findings.recommendation: If production console-warning leakage is observed post-deploy, swap to the Composition-mode equivalents in a follow-up: `missingWarn: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` and `fallbackWarn: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` (note inverted polarity — these flags ENABLE warnings, so production should disable them). No action required for this feature — current keys are AC-compliant by literal text and prebuild check-locales gate already prevents missing keys from reaching production. Tracked as approved deviation per decisions.md Task 2.
findings.anchored_to: Decision 9 (silent prod warnings); AC11 (Vue I18n production-mode config); decisions.md Task 2 'Deviations' entry (already disclosed).

findings.issue: errors.verifyEmail.{400,410,429,generic} keys exist in both locale dictionaries (uk.json:166-171, en.json:166-171) but are unreachable at runtime. verify-email.vue does not import useApiError — it uses a state-machine pattern (state.value = 'expired' | 'invalid') and renders fixed keys auth.verifyEmail.{invalidMessage,expiredMessage,resendError} from a different namespace. The errors.verifyEmail.* branch of the dictionary is dead weight: maintainers may add 4xx codes assuming they're surfaced, but the page never reads them. Symmetric in both locales (AC2 parity holds).
findings.recommendation: Either (a) wire verify-email.vue's resend catch block to useApiError(err, 'verifyEmail') so the keys become reachable for the resend flow (currently line 110 sets resendStatus='error' which renders auth.verifyEmail.resendError — a hardcoded localized fallback), or (b) delete the errors.verifyEmail.* sub-tree from both locale files to remove dead keys. Option (a) is more consistent with other auth pages; option (b) is faster. Pre-deploy QA blocker priority: low — does not affect user-visible behavior, only architectural consistency.
findings.anchored_to: Decision 8 (locale-files namespace structure); Decision 10 (useApiError factory + te() fallback chain — namespace exists but has no consumer).
